flows.name: Select and submit a canonical billing period
steps: Open owner invoice creation for a project with billing periods
Confirm the open or most recent record is selected
Choose another available period when present
Submit or inspect the atomic request contract
flows.expectedOutcome: The form and atomic API use one project-scoped billing-period ID and its canonical date range

flows.name: Fail loudly when no valid billing period is available
steps: Open a project without billing periods or send a missing/foreign ID
flows.expectedOutcome: Creation is blocked with a specific recovery path and no invoice is persisted

checks: Billing period is a labeled select control
Loading, empty, and failure states remain legible
Primary create action is not duplicated
No horizontal page overflow or new wrapper-card noise

claims.description: Billing Period is selected from canonical project records and defaults deterministically
The atomic API validates project scope and applies canonical period dates
Missing, conflicting, foreign, and unavailable periods fail specifically
Desktop and mobile exact-route visual review passes
Independent reviewers approve functional, visual, and evidence quality
